title: StockASkill: A Local-First AgentSkill for Intelligent Stock Selection
title_zh: StockASkill：一个本地优先的智能股票选择AgentSkill

paragraphs.en: Quantitative equity selection and portfolio construction in emerging and cross-border financial markets frequently encounter significant architectural friction: computational bottlenecks from row-oriented iterative scans, remote API rate exhaustion, lookahead and survivorship biases, and rigid real-world execution constraints (e.g., discrete board lots and investor-mandated drawdown limits). In this paper, we present StockASkill , a local-first, full-data-driven AgentSkill engineered as a specialized Quant Co-Processor for autonomous AI agents and quantitative researchers to perform intelligent stock selection and goal-constrained portfolio optimization. Tailored specifically for agile quantitative accounts, family offices, and autonomous AI trading agents with capital scale in the range 10 5 ∼ 10 7 10^{5}\sim 10^{7} RMB where discrete board lot rounding and cash buffer protection are mandatory real-world requirements, StockASkill establishes an embedded columnar Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) foundation atop DuckDB over 42.44 million historical price records and 186,432 quarterly accounting disclosures spanning 26 years across China A-shares, Hong Kong, US equities, and ETFs. By eliminating ad-hoc remote network dependencies during analysis, StockASkill reduces full-market multi-factor cross-sectional screening latency across 5,400+ equities from over 25 seconds to sub-0.5 seconds (a 95%+ performance gain). We formalize an end-to-end mathematical pipeline integrating a 7+1 factor alpha baseline model, a Sequential Least Squares Programming (SLSQP) convex optimizer operating under smooth surrogate drawdown bounds with exact path validation, dynamic 100-share board lot integer quantization, and an autonomous thesis lifecycle finite-state machine. Furthermore, we provide a zero-disk, strongly-typed JSON streaming interface designed specifically for high-throughput LLM agent tool-calling. The complete source code, documentation, and reproducible pipelines are open-sourced at https://github.com/axjing/stockaskill . Comprehensive empirical benchmarks validate the computational scalability, out-of-sample risk-adjusted return characteristics, and operational resilience of the proposed AgentSkill architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 新兴市场与跨境金融市场中的量化选股与组合构建经常面临显著的架构性摩擦：面向行的迭代扫描带来的计算瓶颈、远程 API 速率耗尽、前视偏差与幸存者偏差，以及严苛的现实执行约束（例如，离散整手交易和投资者规定的回撤上限）。 本文提出 StockASkill，一个本地优先、全数据驱动的 AgentSkill，被设计为专用的量化协处理器（Quant Co-Processor），供自主 AI 智能体与量化研究人员执行智能选股和目标约束下的组合优化。 StockASkill 专为资本规模在 10 5 ∼ 10 7 10^{5}\sim 10^{7} 人民币区间、且离散整手取整和现金缓冲保护是强制性现实需求的敏捷量化账户、家族办公室和自主 AI 交易智能体量身打造，它在 DuckDB 之上构建了嵌入式列式在线分析处理（OLAP）基础，涵盖 4244 万条历史价格记录和 186,432 条季度会计披露，跨越 26 年，覆盖中国 A 股、港股、美股和 ETF。 通过消除分析过程中临时的远程网络依赖，StockASkill 将跨 5,400 多只股票的全市场多因子横截面筛选延迟从超过 25 秒降至 0.5 秒以下（性能提升 95% 以上）。 我们形式化了一条端到端数学流水线，集成了 7+1 因子 Alpha 基线模型、在平滑代理回撤边界与精确路径验证约束下运行的序列最小二乘规划（SLSQP）凸优化器、动态 100 股整手整数化，以及自主论点生命周期有限状态机。 此外，我们提供了专为高通量 LLM 智能体工具调用设计的零磁盘、强类型 JSON 流式接口。 完整源代码、文档和可复现流水线已在 https://github.com/axjing/stockaskill 开源。 全面的实证基准测试验证了所提出的 AgentSkill 架构的计算可扩展性、样本外风险调整收益特征和运行韧性。

paragraphs.en: The democratization of quantitative finance and algorithmic portfolio management has expanded rapidly over the past decade. Individual quants, family offices, and autonomous AI agents now require institutional-grade decision engines capable of evaluating massive cross-sections of financial instruments across multiple asset classes and historical market regimes [ 1 , 2 ] . paragraphs.en: Remote Query Fragility and Rate-Limit Exhaustion: Most quantitative toolkits rely on remote public REST/RPC APIs (e.g., EastMoney, Sina, Yahoo Finance) as their primary query layer. Repeatedly fetching long-term historical bars for cross-sectional screening inevitably triggers rate limits, socket disconnects ( RemoteDisconnected ), or IP throttling.
paragraphs.zh: 远程查询脆弱性与限流耗尽：大多数量化工具包依赖远程公共 REST/RPC API（例如东方财富、新浪、雅虎财经）作为其主要查询层。 为横截面筛选而反复获取长期历史K线数据，不可避免地会触发限流、套接字断开（RemoteDisconnected）或IP节流。

paragraphs.en: Row-Oriented and Iterative Compute Inefficiencies: Evaluating multi-factor models across 5,000+ stocks typically involves iterative Python loops or row-oriented SQLite transactions, incurring severe interpretive overhead and latency exceeding 30 seconds per scan.
paragraphs.zh: 面向行的迭代计算低效：在 5,000+ 只股票上评估多因子模型通常涉及迭代的 Python 循环或面向行的 SQLite 事务，带来严重的解释器开销和超过 30 秒的单次扫描延迟。

paragraphs.en: The Disconnect Between Theoretical Alpha and Discrete Execution: Traditional Mean-Variance Optimizers (MVO) [ 3 ] output continuous theoretical weights (e.g., 3.471%) while ignoring rigid real-world execution constraints. In markets such as the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges, equities must be traded strictly in 100-share integer board lots ( shou ), and investor mandates demand strict bounds on Target CAGR and Maximum Drawdown.
paragraphs.zh: 理论Alpha与离散执行之间的脱节：传统均值-方差优化器（MVO）[ 3 ] 输出连续的理论权重（例如3.471%），却忽视了现实世界中刚性的执行约束。 在上海和深圳证券交易所等市场中，股票必须严格以100股整数手为单位进行交易，且投资者的委托要求对目标年复合增长率（Target CAGR）和最大回撤（Maximum Drawdown）设定严格的界限。

paragraphs.en: To systematically resolve these challenges, we introduce StockASkill , a high-performance, local-first AgentSkill engineered for intelligent stock selection and goal-constrained portfolio optimization. Conforming to the open AgentSkills specification, StockASkill transforms raw financial market data into actionable mathematical alpha through a strictly local-first paradigm: a unified, 42.44-million-row DuckDB columnar analytical database serves as the single active source of truth. Remote APIs function purely as dynamic, watermark-driven incremental ingestion pipes rather than ad-hoc query layers.
paragraphs.zh: 为系统性地解决这些挑战，我们推出了 StockASkill，一个高性能、本地优先的智能体技能，专为智能选股和目标约束下的投资组合优化而设计。 StockASkill 遵循开放的 AgentSkills 规范，通过严格本地优先的范式将原始金融市场数据转化为可操作的数学 alpha：一个统一的、包含 4244 万行数据的 DuckDB 列式分析数据库作为唯一有效的事实来源。 远程 API 纯粹充当由水位线驱动的动态增量摄取管道，而非临时性的查询层。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Quant Co-Processor Architecture for AI Agents: We establish a hybrid cognitive-computational paradigm where the autonomous LLM agent formulates qualitative hypotheses and macro directives, while StockASkill serves as a zero-disk, deterministic quant co-processor executing sub-second mathematical optimizations tailored for 10 5 ∼ 10 7 10^{5}\sim 10^{7} RMB capital capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 面向AI智能体的量化协处理器架构：我们建立了一种认知—计算混合范式，其中自主LLM智能体负责制定定性假设与宏观指令，而StockASkill则作为一个零磁盘、确定性的量化协处理器，执行针对 10 5 ∼ 10 7 10^{5}\sim 10^{7} 人民币资金规模的亚秒级数学优化。

paragraphs.en: Local-First Columnar Data Lake: We design a local-first storage foundation utilizing DuckDB [ 4 ] maintaining 42.44 million rows spanning 26 years (1998–2024+) across China A-shares, Hong Kong, US equities, and ETFs, with dynamic watermark synchronization and autonomous multi-source circuit breakers.
paragraphs.zh: 本地优先的列式数据湖：我们设计了一个本地优先的存储基础，利用 DuckDB [ 4 ] 维护 4244 万行数据，涵盖 26 年（1998–2024+）的中国 A 股、港股、美股及 ETF，并具备动态水位线同步与自主多源熔断机制。

paragraphs.en: Sub-Second Intelligent Stock Selection Skill: We formalize an intelligent stock selection skill executing a 7+1 multi-factor alpha scoring model over vectorized SIMD analytical window functions, achieving sub-0.5s screening over 5,400+ equity instruments—a 95%+ latency reduction compared to conventional architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 亚秒级智能选股技能：我们对一种智能选股技能进行了形式化，该技能在向量化的 SIMD 分析窗口函数之上执行 7+1 多因子 Alpha 评分模型，可对 5,400+ 只股票标的实现亚 0.5 秒的筛选——相比传统架构延迟降低 95% 以上。

paragraphs.en: Goal-Constrained SLSQP Optimization with Discrete Rounding: We formulate a non-linear convex optimization model that maximizes the portfolio Sharpe ratio under dual rigid user constraints (Target CAGR ≥ γ target \geq\gamma_{\text{target}} and Maximum Drawdown ≤ MDD max \leq\text{MDD}_{\text{max}} ) solved via smooth convex relaxation, combined with dynamic macro risk budgeting and exact 100-share board lot integer quantization.
paragraphs.zh: 带离散取整的目标约束SLSQP优化：我们构建了一个非线性凸优化模型，在双重刚性用户约束（目标CAGR ≥ γ target \geq\gamma_{\text{target}} 与最大回撤 ≤ MDD max \leq\text{MDD}_{\text{max}} ）下最大化投资组合的夏普比率，该模型通过平滑凸松弛求解，并结合动态宏观风险预算与精确的100股整手整数化量化。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous Thesis Lifecycle Tracking: We establish a finite-state machine (FSM) that tracks investment theses across their entire active lifecycle, incorporating trailing-stop risk patrols, catalyst tracking, and postmortem performance attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 自主投资论点生命周期追踪：我们建立了一个有限状态机（FSM），在整个活跃生命周期内追踪投资论点，融合移动止损风险巡检、催化剂追踪以及事后表现归因。

paragraphs.en: Zero-Disk AgentSkill Streaming Protocol: We implement a standardized AgentSkill interface conforming to the AgentSkills specification, streaming validated, strongly typed JSON payloads directly to stdout for zero-disk-overhead consumption by autonomous LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 零磁盘智能体技能流式传输协议：我们实现了一个符合 AgentSkills 规范的标准化智能体技能（AgentSkill）接口，将经过验证的强类型 JSON 载荷直接流式输出到 stdout，供自主 LLM 智能体以零磁盘开销的方式消费。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative investment research relies heavily on backtesting frameworks to validate alpha hypotheses. Early open-source systems such as Zipline and Backtrader pioneered event-driven simulation, yet their row-by-row Python loop interpretations incur prohibitive execution latencies when scaling across thousands of securities over multi-decade horizons. Modern platforms, notably Microsoft Qlib [ 5 ] , leverage vectorized NumPy/C++ kernels and proprietary binary array storage to accelerate offline machine learning model training. However, existing platforms are engineered primarily for human-in-the-loop Jupyter environments or distributed client-server clusters. They lack standardized, zero-disk tool-calling interfaces for autonomous language agents, require complex infrastructure setup, and neglect discrete board lot execution rounding during portfolio construction. StockASkill bridges this gap by embedding a lightweight, zero-dependency columnar OLAP engine directly into the application process.
paragraphs.zh: 量化投资研究在很大程度上依赖回测框架来验证 Alpha 假设。 早期的开源系统（如 Zipline 和 Backtrader）开创了事件驱动模拟，但它们逐行解释 Python 循环的方式，在跨越数千只证券、长达数十年的时间范围上进行扩展时，会产生令人望而却步的执行延迟。 现代平台，尤其是 Microsoft Qlib [ 5 ]，利用向量化的 NumPy/C++ 内核和专有的二进制数组存储来加速离线机器学习模型训练。 然而，现有平台的设计主要面向人在回路中的 Jupyter 环境，或分布式客户端-服务器集群。 它们缺乏面向自主语言智能体的标准化、零磁盘的工具调用接口，需要复杂的基础设施搭建，并且在投资组合构建过程中忽略了离散整数手（board lot）执行取整。 StockASkill 通过将一个轻量级、零依赖的列式 OLAP 引擎直接嵌入应用程序进程，弥合了这一差距。

paragraphs.en: The advent of large language models has sparked significant interest in financial AI, ranging from domain-adapted foundation models such as FinGPT [ 2 ] to autonomous agent frameworks using ReAct [ 6 ] and Toolformer paradigms. While LLMs excel at processing unstructured financial texts, corporate disclosures, and sentiment signals, empirical studies demonstrate that foundation models suffer from severe numerical hallucinations, arithmetic fragility, and high token overhead when performing multi-asset portfolio optimizations or large-scale matrix operations. Furthermore, standard CLI tools emit decorative ANSI terminal formatting that inflates token budgets and induces parsing failures. StockASkill formalizes a decoupled Quant Co-Processor architecture: the agent handles qualitative reasoning and strategic goal setting, while StockASkill guarantees deterministic, sub-second mathematical optimization streamed via strongly typed JSON.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的出现引发了人们对金融人工智能的极大兴趣，从 FinGPT [ 2 ] 等领域适配的基础模型，到使用 ReAct [ 6 ] 和 Toolformer 范式的自主智能体框架，均是如此。 尽管大语言模型擅长处理非结构化金融文本、公司披露文件和情绪信号，但实证研究表明，基础模型在执行多资产投资组合优化或大规模矩阵运算时，存在严重的数值幻觉、算术脆弱性和高昂的 token 开销。 此外，标准 CLI 工具会输出装饰性的 ANSI 终端格式，这会膨胀 token 预算并导致解析失败。 StockASkill 形式化了一种解耦的量化协处理器（Quant Co-Processor）架构：智能体负责定性推理与战略目标设定，而 StockASkill 通过强类型 JSON 流式输出，保证确定性的亚秒级数学优化。

paragraphs.en: Columnar database management systems have fundamentally reshaped analytical query processing [ 7 ] . Recent innovations in embeddable columnar stores, exemplified by DuckDB [ 4 ] , demonstrate that vectorized execution algorithms utilizing modern SIMD hardware primitives (AVX-512, AVX2, NEON) can outpace distributed clusters on single-node analytical workloads. paragraphs.en: To eliminate unexecutable survivorship bias and micro-cap illiquidity distortions in real-world trading, the data ingestion and screening pipelines enforce strict statutory investability filters: (i) Special Treatment & Delisting Guard: Automatic exclusion of equities flagged with ST, *ST, or entering exchange delisting transition periods; (ii) Seasoning Window: Exclusion of newly listed equities with fewer than 60 exchange trading days to prevent anomalous secondary listing volatility; (iii) Liquidity Tail Truncation: Exclusion of the bottom 10% trailing 20-day average daily turnover quantile, filtering out illiquid micro-caps with severe market impact; (iv) Execution Limit-Price Sentry: Explicit tracking of statutory limit-up ( + 10 % / + 20 % +10\%/+20\% ) and limit-down ( − 10 % / − 20 % -10\%/-20\% ) price states, preventing unexecutable buying at ceiling prices or forced selling at frozen floor prices.
paragraphs.zh: 为消除真实交易中的不可执行幸存者偏差与微盘股流动性失真，数据接入与筛选流程执行严格的法定可投资性过滤：(i) 特别处理与退市防护：自动剔除被标记为 ST、*ST 或进入交易所退市过渡期的股票；(ii) 上市观察窗口：剔除上市交易天数不足 60 个交易日的次新股，以防止异常的重新上市波动；(iii) 流动性尾部截断：剔除过去 20 日日均成交额处于最低 10% 分位的股票，过滤掉市场冲击严重的流动性欠佳微盘股；(iv) 涨跌停价格哨兵：显式跟踪法定涨停（ + 10 % / + 20 % +10\%/+20\% ）与跌停（ − 10 % / − 20 % -10\%/-20\% ）价格状态，防止在涨停板价格上的不可执行买入或在跌停冻结价格上的强制卖出。

paragraphs.en: Smooth Surrogate Approximation and Exact Validation: In its raw mathematical form, the sample-path maximum drawdown MDD ​ ( w ) \text{MDD}(w) is a piecewise-linear, non-differentiable minimax function. Its non-smooth gradient discontinuities can destabilize standard Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) gradient approximations. paragraphs.en: StockASkill is designed from the ground up to comply with the AgentSkills.io open specification [ 23 ] . Standard quantitative command-line interfaces emit decorative ASCII tables and progress bars designed for terminal human viewing. When invoked by LLM agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex), visual formatting causes three issues: (i) inflated prompt token consumption, (ii) parsing fragility via regular expressions, and (iii) I/O latency from temporary intermediate files.
paragraphs.zh: StockASkill 从设计之初就遵循 AgentSkills.io 开放规范 [ 23 ]。 标准的量化命令行界面会输出用于终端人工查看的装饰性 ASCII 表格和进度条。 当被 LLM 智能体（例如 Claude Code、OpenCode、Codex）调用时，视觉格式化会引发三个问题：(i) 提示词 token 消耗膨胀，(ii) 依赖正则表达式解析的脆弱性，以及 (iii) 临时中间文件带来的 I/O 延迟。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduced StockASkill, an offline-first, full-data-driven quantitative decision engine engineered as a specialized Quant Co-Processor for autonomous AI agents. By utilizing an embedded 42.44M-row DuckDB columnar OLAP store, StockASkill eliminates remote API fragility and reduces cross-sectional screening latency across 5,400+ equities to sub-0.5 seconds. We formalized a goal-constrained SLSQP optimizer operating under smooth surrogate drawdown bounds with exact path projection, incorporating real-world 100-share board lot constraints and macro regime budgeting, alongside a finite-state thesis tracking architecture and a zero-disk streaming protocol for autonomous LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 StockASkill，一个离线优先、全数据驱动的量化决策引擎，其设计定位是作为自主 AI 智能体的专用量化协处理器（Quant Co-Processor）。 通过利用一个内嵌的 4244 万行 DuckDB 列式 OLAP 存储，StockASkill 消除了远程 API 的脆弱性，并将 5400 余只股票的横截面筛选延迟降低至 0.5 秒以内。 我们形式化了一个目标约束下的 SLSQP 优化器，该优化器在具有精确路径投影的平滑代理回撤约束下运行，融入了现实中的 100 股整手交易约束与宏观状态预算机制，并配套一个有限状态论点跟踪架构和一个面向自主 LLM 智能体的零磁盘流式传输协议。

paragraphs.en: Future extensions include: (i) All-Weather Multi-Asset Risk Parity: Expanding beyond equities to balance risk contributions across government bonds, commodities, and inflation-protected ETFs; (ii) End-to-End Non-Linear Learned Representations: Integrating gradient-boosted decision trees and sequence neural embeddings directly into the DuckDB analytical morsel via the open feature plug-in interface; and (iii) Multi-Agent Consensus Protocols: Extending the AgentSkills specification to multi-agent adversarial setups (e.g., Fundamental Analyst Agent versus Risk Sentry Agent) with formal execution guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的扩展方向包括：(i) 全天候多资产风险平价：将范围从股票扩展至政府债券、大宗商品和通胀保值ETF，以平衡各资产的风险贡献；(ii) 端到端非线性学习表示：通过开放的特征插件接口，将梯度提升决策树和序列神经嵌入直接集成到 DuckDB 分析数据块中；(iii) 多智能体共识协议：将 AgentSkills 规范扩展到多智能体对抗场景（例如基本面分析师智能体对阵风险哨兵智能体），并提供正式的执行保证。
